title: Total spend limit for testing one agent and the High Table comparison
context: Chief architect gap: authoring_run_max_cost_usd caps only one trial. One agent needs 24 to 36 eval trials plus 48 to 60 delegation runs per iteration, up to 3 iterations, on two model tiers, and the one-time High Table comparison (paqad-ai experts benchmark) replays at least 18 full reviews. Only the owner can say how much money the total may reach before paqad stops and asks.
